open_release.rationale: GEM produces a differentially private sanitized dataset intended for release of query answers.

quotes.text: construct a sanitized version of a sensitive dataset, subject to differential privacy, that approximately preserves the answers to a large collection of statistical queries

pipeline_testing.rationale: The sources do not frame the output as test data for software or pipelines.

ml_augmentation.rationale: The paper explicitly targets query release and contrasts itself with methods aimed at downstream machine learning tasks.

statistical_replication.rationale: Evaluation measures the maximum error over statistical queries such as 3-way marginals, i.e. how well statistics are preserved.

quotes.text: approximately preserves the answers to a large collection of statistical queries

causal_inference.rationale: No causal structure or intervention framing appears in the sources.

education.rationale: The paper and README have no teaching or tutorial framing.

benchmarking.rationale: GEM is compared against baselines in its own experiments but is not itself used as a baseline or benchmark in the sources.

imbalance_correction.rationale: No class-imbalance or minority-class framing appears in the sources.
